1.text: Iyaba wari nka musaza wanjye wonkejwe na mama,Nagusanga hanze nkagusoma,Kandi nta wabingaya.

2.text: Nakujyana nkakugeza mu nzu ya mama akanyigisha,Nkagusomya kuri vino ituriye,No ku mazi y'imikomamanga.

3.text: Wasanga ansheguje ukuboko kw'ibumoso,Ukw'iburyo kumpfumbase. Umukwe:

4.text: Yemwe bakobwa b'i Yerusalemu ndabarahirije,Ntimukangure umukunzi wanjye ngo abyuke,Kugeza igihe abyishakira. Abakobwa:

5.text: Uriya ni nde uje azamuka ava mu butayu,Yegamiranye n'umukunzi we? Umukwe:Nakubyukije munsi y'umutapuwa,Aho ni ho nyoko yakuramukwaga,Ni koko uwakubyaye ni ho yakuramutswe. Umugeni:

6.text: Unshyire mu gituza cyawe mbe ikimenyetso,Mbe no ku kuboko kwawe.Kuko urukundo rukomeye nk'urupfu,Kandi ifuha ntirigondeka ni nk'imva,Ibirimi byarwo ni nk'iby'umuriro,Ni umuriro rwose w'Uwiteka. Umukwe:

7.text: Amazi menshi ntiyazimya urukundo,N'inzuzi zuzuye ntizarurenga hejuru.Umuntu watanga ibyo afite mu rugo rwe byose,Kugira ngo agure urukundo,Yagawa rwose. Umugeni:

8.text: Dufite murumuna wacu utarapfundura amabere,Tuzamugira dute igihe azasabirwa? Umukwe:

9.text: Niba ameze nk'inkike z'amabuye,Tuzamwubakaho umunara w'ifeza,Niba ameze nk'umuryango,Tuzamukingira n'imbaho z'imyerezi. Umugeni:

10.text: Jyeweho ndi inkike z'amabuye,N'amabere yanjye ni nk'iminara yazo,Ni cyo cyatumye mu maso h'umugabo wanjye mubera nk'ubonye amahoro.

11.text: Salomo yari afite uruzabibu i Bālihamoni.Arugabanya abarinzi,Umuntu wese muri bo yategetswe kujya atanga ibice by'ifeza igihumbi ku mwero warwo.

12.text: Uruzabibu rwanjye bwite ruri imbere yanjye,Yewe Salomo, uzabona igihumbi cyawe,Kandi abarinzi b'imbuto na bo bazabona magana abiri.

13.text: Yewe uba mu mirima,Bagenzi banjye bategere ijwi ryawe amatwi,Urinyumvishe.

14.text: Mukunzi wanjye banguka,Umere nk'isirabo cyangwa umucanzogera w'impara,Mu mpinga z'imisozi y'imibavu.
